text: The authors assess easy-to-hard generalization by fitting models to easy data and testing them on hard data ('easy-to-hard'), comparing against an oracle upper bound that has labeled hard data for finetuning ('hard-to-hard') and an unsupervised lower bound that is prompted zero-shot ('unsupervised-to-hard').
title: Easy-to-hard generalization protocol with hard-to-hard oracle and zero-shot lower bound
